The Central Weather Service issued a news bulletin early in the morning (10) about the launch of yellow lights throughout the 15 counties and cities of Lancheng and Green Island to alert the public to the security risks posed by the strong winds. 29 minutes ago, half the Taiwan was swept away! 15 counties were lit with yellow lights.

heads.t: 天氣／雲階現蹤！冷空氣一路往南衝「北東濕涼」 這天才回溫 氣象專家林得恩曬出衛星雲圖指出，受入秋最有感冷空氣影響，加上氣壓梯度增大，風寒效應顯著，迎風面的北部、東北部及東部地區天氣明顯轉為涼冷，雲圖上出現一階一階的「雲階」，代表冷空氣正持續在往南衝。 47 分鐘前｜生活 天氣／雲階現蹤！冷空氣一路往南衝「北東濕涼」 這天才回溫 47 分鐘前｜生活
heads.en: The weather/climate shows that the cold air travels southwards towards the "dry north east" and this is the day when the weather expert Lindhan suns out the satellite cloud map, indicating that the cold air most affected by the onset of the autumn, combined with an increase in the gradient of the pressure, the effect of the wind should be visible, the weather in the north, north-east and east of the wind is clearly cold, and there is a layer of "cloud" on the cloud, representing a continuing southward movement. 47 minutes ago, the weather/clouds were moving southwards.
